district_name: West River Modified Union Education District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(D) inventory: West River Modified Union Education District, a modified union district in the Windham Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Brookline, Jamaica, Newfane, Townshend for PK-12; Windham for grades 7-12 only).

board.org_name: West River Modified Union Education District Board

sources.note: WCSU WRED Board Members page (official, fetched 2026-10-22; roster recovered from the page's raw HTML member cards -- rendered-text extraction drops every card): Townshend -- Winrich (Chairperson) exp. 2029, Claussen (Vice-Chairperson) exp. 2029; Brookline -- Jillson (Clerk) exp. 2029; Jamaica -- West exp. 2028, Hazelton exp. 2027; Newfane -- Long exp. 2028, Bertram exp. 2027; Windham -- Pelton exp. 2028; At-large -- Webb ("At Large (Brookline)") exp. 2027, Gehring ("At Large (Newfane)") exp. 2026; and Chevalier, exp. 2029, with NO town published on her card. MODEL: town seats are elected by their own towns at town meeting (Townshend 2023 town report; Jamaica 2020 town meeting minutes) and at-large seats on the district ballot (official April 8, 2026 ballot, Art. 9: one at-large director, 3-year term, district-wide commingled count). HELD: the at-large seat published exp. 2026 (Gehring) -- the April 2026 ballot warned it with NO printed candidate (write-in only) and no certified return was fetched. Chevalier is minted in the at-large post (the only seat class filled in 2026 carrying a 2029 expiry, matching the Art. 9 article), flagged: if the certified return or the Articles show a town seat, she moves. Board size 11 and the allocation rest on the roster cards; the Articles of Agreement were not fetched. Excluded (not directors): the district's elected officers (Wilson, Clerk; Liebow, Moderator; Russ, Treasurer) and two student members.
